about: quest monsters the period says roam or wander without a route: a roaming range instead of a path

entries.why: Erich stood still; period 'a woman the roams among the undead' (part04 C10): a small roaming range (part04 B3 moves her spot)
the Wandering Drakoran Scout did not wander (roam 0); the period gives only 'found around 47324, 21517', which is its spot: a roaming range round it
all 46 decaying marshmen stood still (roam 0) round Wearyall Village; Allakhazam 1782 'decaying marshmen who can be found roaming around Wearyall Village': a roaming range of 400
The Blademaster stood still (Bri Leith 410811,538011, roam 0); Allakhazam 180 'The Blademaster wanders around here': the quest's The Blademaster roams (200, like the twin did)

a second, roaming level 15 'Blademaster' (Public_DB) stood 320 units from the quest's 'The Blademaster'; killing it never counted for Cad Goddeau A (TargetName 'The Blademaster;200'): one Blademaster kept, the twin archived
Saemus only drifted (roam 200) in the Bog of Cullen; period 'He roams the Bog of Cullen' / 'moves around some, but in the water': a wider roaming range
the hag stood still (Bog of Cullen 42200,17100, roam 0); period 'She roams the Bog of Cullen': a small roaming range
Scuttle stood still alone (Silvermine 15694,52756, roam 0); period 'He was trailed by another bear cub': a small roaming range and a fishing bear cub (a copy of the Lough Derg ones) that trails him
Scuttle 'was trailed by another bear cub' but stood alone (a copy of fishing bear cub 1bbd6160-3294-419f-907d-aa960cf5e7d7, same template and stats, walking with Scuttle)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 97 Scuttle: 'a Fishing Bear Cub named Scuttle'; period comment 'He was trailed by another bear cub'

entries.why: new fishing bear cub (00071101-0000-4000-8000-000000000020) is a fellow of Scuttle

the Undead Patrol was a static all-day spawn; walkthrough 194 'Kill a roaming undead patrol ... They only spawn near midnight', our step text 'Slay a roaming undead patrol': a night spawn with a roaming range
Siv Alfevson stood still; walkthrough 208 'he appears to roam around the island': a roaming range
Jodis Rindasdottir stood still; walkthrough 1768 'roaming around on top of a hill': a roaming range
Strykel stood still; walkthrough 'said to roam a fiery island': a roaming range

the Nisse's Lair Haunt never moved (roam -1); walkthrough 509 'The haunt patrols within sight of the ramp from the Shaman room': a small roaming range in its room (a navmesh roam stays on connected floor)
Hnaki never moved (roam -1); walkthrough 509 'He patrols not deep in to the new area of Nisse's Lair': a small roaming range
